decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft default: options close to afternoon may be acceptable when true afternoon return departures are limited or otherwise unattractive.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon return-flight departures, or nearby times when afternoon options are unattractive.
decisions.condition: When booking or comparing round-trip flights, especially when specifying the return leg departure time.
decisions.default_action: Search for return-flight options that leave in the afternoon; if multiple afternoon options are available, present those first and let the user choose a specific time.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not apply to outbound legs as a universal rule, because one supporting dialogue explicitly used a morning outbound departure while still preferring an afternoon return.
decisions.name: afternoon_return_departure_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer the return flight to depart in the afternoon.
decisions.rationale: Repeated evidence across three dialogues supports a reusable soft preference for afternoon return departures. The evidence also explicitly limits this policy from becoming a universal outbound-leg rule.

decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a time-of-day preference for flight departures, without tying it to a particular route, date, or leg type
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer morning flight departures when no trip-specific timing requirement overrides the preference.
decisions.condition: When choosing a flight departure time and no trip-specific timing requirement applies
decisions.exception_condition: No reusable fallback is established; ask before relaxing the preference when morning options are unavailable
decisions.name: Prefer morning flight departures
decisions.rationale: Three dialogues support a reusable morning departure preference across flight searches. It contrasts with, but is not an alias of, the leg-specific afternoon return preference, so it remains a separate policy.
